name: digesting-bilibili-videos
title_zh: B站视频存下来，顺手变成能搜的中文 PDF
tagline_zh: 收藏夹里躺了几百个「以后再看」，真要看时又懒得拖进度条。它把官方 AI 字幕扒成纯文本。
tagline_en: Your Bilibili watch-later pile never gets watched. This pulls the official AI subtitles into plain text, then.
desc_en: Downloads bilibili videos and turns their official AI subtitles into readable transcripts, OPML mindmaps, outlines and searchable Chinese PDFs. Use when downloading, saving or archiving a B站/BV号/哔哩哔哩 video locally, grabbing its cover image or metadata, getting a video's subtitles or transcript, turning an episode into a readable article, mindmap, outline or PDF, when a downloaded mp4 turns out cor
why_zh: 走的是官方 AI 字幕而不是自己跑语音识别，所以又快又不用显卡；字幕断句、时间轴、章节都保留下来。
why_en: It uses Bilibili's own AI subtitles instead of running speech recognition, so it's fast and GPU-free. Sentence breaks.
limit_zh: 只对开了官方 AI 字幕的视频有效，UP 主没开或纯音乐、方言重的片子拿不到字幕；产物到文字稿和 PDF 为止。
limit_en: Only works on videos with official AI subtitles enabled; no subtitles means no output. Stops at transcript and PDF — no translation, no summarization.
title_en: Save a Bilibili video, get a searchable Chinese PDF
